Layout uniformtext objects

Source: R/zz-gen-layout.R
go_layout_uniformtext.Rd

Properties of layout.uniformtext.

Usage

go_layout_uniformtext(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  minsize = NULL,
  mode = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

Arguments

arg

Optional named list, or graph object of the same type, to initialise properties from (constructors). Named arguments take precedence.

...

Further properties, including nested properties in "magic underscore" form, e.g. marker_size = 10 for marker = list(size = 10). Property values may be one-sided formulas, evaluated in data for add_*() functions.

minsize

Sets the minimum text size between traces of the same type. Number in the interval [0, Inf].

mode

Determines how the font size for various text elements are uniformed between each trace type. If the computed text sizes were smaller than the minimum size defined by `uniformtext.minsize` using "hide" option hides the text; and using "show" option shows the text without further downscaling. Please note that if the size defined by `minsize` is greater than the font size defined by trace, then the `minsize` is used. One of "hide", "show", FALSE.

skip_invalid

If TRUE, silently drop invalid properties instead of raising an error.

Value

Each go_*() function returns a graph object of the same class as its name; add_*() functions return the modified figure.

Details

go_layout_uniformtext() create validated graph objects (named lists). Every property is checked against the plotly.js schema when an object is created or modified (see plotly_obj-modify()).

See also

go_layout()
